# Specs

Machine-readable constraints. Find the architecture whose *applies when* matches the
task, then load its JSON and the layer specs it composes. Rules are listed here so a
finding can cite an id without reading every ruleset.

## Architectures

### `queue-architecture` — Queue architecture

**Applies when:** Work must happen outside a request, may be retried, and must survive the process that scheduled it.

- Layers: consumer → job-handler → queue-manager
- Rulesets: shared
- Templates: 1
- Spec: [`specs/architectures/queue-architecture.json`](../specs/architectures/queue-architecture.json)
- Judgement: [Queue architecture](../kb/patterns/queue-architecture.md)

## Layers

| id | type | must not import |
|---|---|---|
| [`consumer`](../specs/layers/consumer.json) | processing | queue-manager, repository, controller, orm |
| [`job-handler`](../specs/layers/job-handler.json) | business | consumer, queue-manager, bullmq, sqs-consumer, amqplib |
| [`queue-manager`](../specs/layers/queue-manager.json) | infrastructure | consumer, job-handler, service, controller |

## Rules

A rule with a check is mechanically enforceable; the rest need judgement.

| id | scope | severity | check | rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `no-circular-dependencies` | * | error | — | No circular dependencies between modules or layers |
| `unidirectional-dependency-flow` | * | error | — | Dependencies flow in one direction only, along the order declared by the architecture |
| `depend-on-abstractions` | * | warning | — | Depend on interfaces, not concrete implementations, across a layer boundary |
| `consumer-owns-no-infrastructure` | consumer | error | import-boundary | Consumers must not construct or configure queue infrastructure; take the connection by injection |
| `handler-is-transport-agnostic` | job-handler | error | import-boundary | Job handlers must not import the consumer or the queue manager, or any broker client |
| `handlers-are-idempotent` | job-handler | error | — | Job handlers must be safe to run more than once on the same payload |
| `classify-failures-explicitly` | job-handler | error | — | Failures must be thrown as typed errors declaring whether they are retryable |
| `dead-letter-configured` | queue-manager | error | — | Every queue declares a finite retry count and a dead-letter destination |
| `bounded-consumer-concurrency` | consumer | warning | — | Concurrency is configured explicitly, never left at the client default |
| `instrument-depth-and-lag` | queue-manager | warning | — | Expose queue depth, consumer lag and dead-letter volume as metrics |
| `correlate-job-logs` | * | warning | — | Log job id and correlation id on every job lifecycle event |
| `no-hardcoded-secrets` | * | error | — | Never hardcode secrets, connection strings or credentials |
